summary: Verified the RAW AI Studio selection-bug fix and xmp-only ZIP output. Jest suite for the new pure selection engine (src/lib/selectionLogic.js): 6/6 pass. Backend pytest (excluding paid Wikipedia LLM path): 31/31 pass — auth, projects CRUD, style-profiles, cloud-jobs full lifecycle+download, photographer-styles auth/scoping/failure, startup reaper, /api/selection/analyze, and generate-xmp. Confirmed independently that POST /api/projects/{id}/generate-xmp with ['A.CR3','B.NEF'] returns a ZIP whose entries are EXACTLY ['A.xmp','B.xmp'] (no LEEME.txt, no extras) and .xmp content contains crs: attributes (crs:Exposure2012, crs:CameraProfile, crs:Contrast2012, crs:Temperature, RawFileName). Same exclusivity holds for GET /api/cloud-jobs/{id}/download.
critical_code_review_comments: selectionLogic.js: correctly replaces prior md5-of-filename randomness with real perceptual-hash grouping + sharpness/exposure combined score; pure & fully unit-testable — good.
AMBIGUOUS_MARGIN logic uses `>= best.combined * 0.92` — this correctly includes the best itself and any runner-up within 8%.
hamming() uses BigInt XOR + bit loop — correct for 64-bit pHashes; test covers it.
server.build_zip() now writes only .xmp entries (LEEME.txt removed) — matches product requirement of exclusively Lightroom-compatible sidecars.
Two pre-existing tests still asserted `LEEME.txt in names`; updated to assert exclusivity (== set of xmp filenames). This is a stale-test fix, not a functional change.

test_iteration5_selection.py used os.environ['MONGO_URL'] which is not exported to the pytest process (only to supervisor-managed backend); made it fall back to /app/backend/.env like sibling test files. Small robustness fix.

Note: canvas/createImageBitmap-based analyzeFile and RAW-thumbnail slice(0,4MB) path are not headless-testable without real CR3/NEF fixtures; verifiable proof is limited to the pure selection engine (jest) + XMP output (pytest), which the request itself acknowledges.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All jest+pytest green. If new selection features are added, keep selectionLogic.js pure so the jest suite stays authoritative. Real RAW-file browser flow (folder picker + 5000 photos) still requires manual/e2e testing with fixtures — not covered here.
rca of the issue: Original bug: quality score was Math.abs(md5(filename)) which is deterministic-but-arbitrary per name, so 'best of sequence' selection was effectively random. Fix: replaced with actual image content metrics (Laplacian variance sharpness + exposure histogram + 8x8 DCT/average-hash pHash), then group by pHash Hamming ≤8 and pick the sharpest; when a runner-up scores ≥92% of the best, also select it (ambiguity). Pure logic isolated in selectionLogic.js and covered by 6 jest tests. XMP-output cleanup (removing LEEME.txt from ZIP) verified via updated pytest asserting exact namelist equality.
